thresholds.source: Chandler & Kerswell 2013 arXiv:1207.4682 (R_thres=0.3 at Re=60, T=1e5 per run) and Lucas & Kerswell 2015 arXiv:1406.1820 (R<0.25, 0.5<T<60 fed to Newton); quoted via writeup/data/p2_route_rpol_v1.json

prefilter.statement: R_red <= R pointwise, because |a-b| >= ||a|-|b|| and every symmetry in the minimisation multiplies each coefficient by a unit-modulus phase; so thresholding the proxy at the same value discards nothing

stratification.why: a global top-N ranks short-period near-recurrences above the T~15-19 band every named Table IV orbit lives in; measured on the first full-length pass, the global 400 yielded exactly ONE anchored, m=0, in-window seed, so U3's pre-registered 100 attempts were unreachable for a reason that is about the ranking, not the flow
stratification.rule: additionally take the best 500 strict local minima within T_ANCHOR_TOL=1.0 of each named published period
stratification.adds_only: the global list is kept whole and nothing is removed; added candidates face the same full minimisation, the same R<R_THRES_WINDOW test and the same m=0 requirement, so this changes which seeds are OFFERED and never what counts as a recovery

prefilter.selection: strict interior local minima of R_red in the (t, T) plane, the papers' own criterion; ranking by R instead fills the budget with T=0.5 cells where the trajectory has barely moved, and those are boundary points that can never be interior minima

full_minimisation.note: minimised over continuous x-shift s AND discrete y-shift m in 0..3, per C&K eq. (23); leg 353 minimised over s only

leg353_comparison.note: leg 353 mined a T=2000 DNS and its best candidates for the eight named Table IV rows sat at R = 0.177-0.263, i.e. at or outside the edge of L&K's own R<0.25 Newton window
